schema.description: Payload for updating a merchant's business information.

name.description: New business name of the merchant.

country.description: Country of the merchant's address, one of: USA, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong (China). Required to update the phone number, as it defines the accepted phone number format.

state.description: State or province of the merchant's address.

zip.description: Postal (ZIP) code of the merchant's address.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number of the merchant, valid for the given country.

schema.title: MerchantUpdateDto
